comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: the sign case. Same K-1 as wages-and-k1-ptp-code-z-single with box 1 still +12,000 and the box 20 code Z amount NEGATIVE, -4,500 — a qualified PTP loss, entered as the Form 8995 line 6 instruction requires. THE CODE Z AMOUNT NEVER TOUCHES SCHEDULE E: it is a section 199A quantity, so the section 469(k) overall gain is still 12,000 in column (k) and total income and AGI are 60,250, exactly the income case's. WHICH LINE FLOORS IT: Form 8995 line 8, 'the total of lines 6 and 7, or zero, whichever is greater' — line 6 = -4,500 and line 7 = 0, so line 8 = 0, line 9 = 20% x 0 = 0, line 10 = 0 and Form 1040 line 13 = 0. The loss stops at the REIT/PTP subtotal and never reduces the line-5 qualified business income component. Taxable income is therefore the undeducted 60,250 - 15,750 = 44,500; income tax 5,105 = tax table row 44,500-44,550, midpoint 44,525 (1,192.50 + 12% x 32,600 = 5,104.50, half-up); total tax 5,105, withholding 6,000, overpayment 895.
